primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-second-observation (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3863-3868

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the orbit E = t(s^{-1}(W)) is set-theoretically R-invariant and sits inside a quasi-compact open W'; the complement image T = t(s^{-1}(Z)) is disjoint from E and, by specialization reachability along the quasi-compact t plus lifting of generalizations along the flat s, its closure T-bar is set-theoretically R-invariant; the complement V = U \ T-bar is then the desired R-invariant open with W subset V (W sits in E, which is disjoint from T and, being open, from its closure) and V subset W' (source lines 3870-3894)
